nodes.name: Schedule — Every 2hr
nodes.notes: Runs every 2 hours. Safe to activate after Gmail OAuth2 credential is wired.

nodes.name: Run Canary Shadow Classifier
nodes.notes: Reads last 25 inbox emails, classifies each 2 ways, writes to audit DB. Never sends/labels/creates missions. Fails soft.

nodes.name: Errors Only Gate
nodes.notes: Only pages Telegram on error. Normal successful runs are silent.

nodes.name: Telegram — Canary Error Alert
nodes.notes: IMPORTANT: Wire the Telegram Bot API credential (D2MC2C bot token) before activating.

_canary_notes.purpose: Phase B email-canary: shadow-classify inbox emails 2 ways, record to audit DB. Zero production risk.
before_activating: 1. Wire Gmail OAuth2 web-client credential in n8n (same client_id/secret as gmail_token.json). Node 'Run Canary Shadow Classifier' calls the Python script which handles auth directly via token file — no n8n Gmail credential needed for the script itself.
2. Wire Telegram Bot credential (D2MC2C bot token) in node 'Telegram — Canary Error Alert'.
4. Set active: true in this JSON and import, OR toggle Active in n8n UI.
_canary_notes.safety: NEVER sends, labels, or creates missions. Read + classify + record only. Fails soft on per-email errors.
